snippets: The cave hums softly with a memory no one has dared to name.
The divers left a map in old chalk marks, but the current stole the route.
Every vent is a heartbeat of the mountain, and the mountain is waking up.
The lantern glass is still warm. Someone was here only moments ago.
The walls whisper in a language of pressure, depth, and longing.
A handprint remains in the silt, fresh as a warning left by a stranger.
